name: Nidhi Rakesh
summary: Software developer with hands-on experience in Python, HTML, JavaScript. Active open-source contributor maintaining 4 repositories on GitHub, including APKSentinel and GitResume.

projects.name: APKSentinel
bullets: Static analysis and graph attention network that labels Android APKs as benign, suspicious, or malicious, with explanations.
APKSentinel reads an Android APK, extracts evidence with four static analysis agents, turns that evidence into a graph, and labels the app as BENIGN, SUSPICIOUS.

**Turn your GitHub projects into ATS-friendly LaTeX resumes.**.
